products.short_description: A repeatable way to implement Entra ID Governance — PIM for just-in-time, approval-gated admin roles, access reviews to recertify access, and entitlement management to package access with expiry, so privilege is least, time-bound, and provable. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Make privileged access just-in-time and prove who has access to what

Standing admin rights and access that never gets reviewed are how breaches escalate and audits fail. Microsoft Entra ID Governance fixes both: Privileged Identity Management (PIM) makes admin roles just-in-time and approval-gated, access reviews recertify who should keep access, and entitlement management packages access with policies and expiry. This solution gives you a repeatable way to implement Entra ID Governance so privilege is least, time-bound, and provable.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — the Entra ID Governance model: PIM (eligible vs active roles, activation, approval, alerts), access reviews (recertification), and entitlement management (access packages, catalogs, policies, expiry), and how they enforce least privilege.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Entra ID Governance / P2 licensing, Global/Privileged Role admin, role and access inventory, approver groups, a pilot scope) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: onboard roles to PIM (eligible + approval + alerts), set up access reviews for privileged and app access, build entitlement-management access packages with policies/expiry, validate activations and recertification, pilot, then expand. Includes break-glass account guidance.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — PIM/reviews/entitlement discovery, privileged-access and review-status validation, a standing-privilege and governance-coverage report, safe remediation of standing admin, and a governance-scope group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Privileged access made just-in-time and approval-gated, access recertified on a schedule, and entitlements packaged with expiry — so privilege is least, time-bound, and provable to an auditor — proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • IGA-Discovery.ps1 — Entra ID Governance posture: PIM roles/eligibility, access reviews, access packages
    • IGA-Remediation.ps1 — safely convert standing (active) Entra admin assignments to PIM eligible
    • IGA-Report.ps1 — standing-privilege and governance-coverage report (Microsoft Graph)
    • IGA-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — build the governance-scope and approver groups for PIM/reviews/packages
    • IGA-Validation.ps1 — confirm privileged roles are eligible (not standing) and activation is gated

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.

Government / GCC High tenant? A dedicated Government (GCC High) edition of this solution is available — authored for the US sovereign cloud (correct *.us portals, US Gov Graph endpoints, and Commercial-vs-GCC-High feature parity gaps called out).
